text:
Maya: Quick async Q for everyone — runtime v3 latency OKR check. One-line status please (shipped / slipped / partial) + any blockers. Owners noted: Sahil (eng-runtime), Dana (eng-platform), Liam (product).

Sahil: shipped -> landed kernel scheduling tweak and continuous batching change. Median p95 dropped ~12ms on internal perf runs. PR: https://git.internal/r/1234. Need Carol to do a CR review on the resource isolate patch (small but infra-adjacent).

Dana: partial -> infra driver update blocked our infra automation (TPU driver mismatch). We've got a temp hotfix (pin older driver) so can run canary but full rollout slips ~2w. Filed infra ticket: https://tickets/redwood/INF-789.

Liam: shipped -> product telemetry updated for the OKR metric, dashboard shows initial improvement. Need eng to confirm the canary window and if we should gate the rollout on extra perf tests.

Carol: ack, will review Sahil's PR today. Pinged me with @carol if urgent. Also saw a small test flake in CI, I'll add a note on the PR. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy created for canary cluster 'v3-latency-canary' by Sahil at `2025-07-12T14:21:00Z`. Canary size: 3 nodes.

Maya: thanks. Quick followups — Sahil, can you own the canary rollout (monitor logs + rollback plan)? Dana, can you confirm the ETA for the driver fix and whether we need platform support during the canary?

Sahil: yep, I can own the canary rollout. Will run `kubectl apply -f canary.yaml` and monitor latency & error rate. I'll post a short runbook in this thread before starting.

Dana: ETA for driver fix is ~2025-07-26 (two weeks). For the canary we can use pinned driver and platform will be on-call if any infra regressions pop. I'll add a note in INF-789 with required env var `ENABLE_DRIVER_PIN=true`.

Carol: reviewed -> left two tiny comments (test mock timing, and a doc tweak). Should be quick.

Liam: from product side, we'll hold feature flags until you confirm green canary results. Also setting a reminder for the cross-team post-mortem if any regressions hit.

Maya: perfect. Action items recap: 1) Sahil = canary rollout + runbook (post in thread) 2) Dana = driver ETA + INF-789 update 3) Carol = finish CR today 4) Liam = hold flags + telemetry check. If anyone needs to swap owners, call it out here. Otherwise I'll mark this as the OKR checkpoint.

Sahil: posting runbook in 15m.

Dana: added note to INF-789 with env var and temporary workaround.

ops-bot: reminder set for 2025-07-26 to follow up on INF-789.

Maya: thanks all — short and solid. If nothing else, we'll reconvene in next week's async milestone digest. :rocket:
